long.text: Learn to shape clay into something worth keeping, and build a small collection of my own finds in the house.
long.reason: Clay is good and so are things I have claimed, and I mean to have both in one place.

steps.reason: The moon's colour is still hidden from me, and I will read about it until somebody explains.
The telescope is mine, and I want to be close enough to look at the moon through it.
I will check the telescope's lenses while nobody is watching, which is only sensible.
The reading lamp is mine, and the photograph keeps the claim on record.
I want to see what has changed on the beach since this morning, and to claim whatever I find first.
My energy is running low, and a patch of sun is the right place to fix that.
The telescope is the biggest thing here and it is mine, so I will photograph it for the record.

today.reason: Hunger cannot be fixed until the bowl is filled in the morning, so I will keep the afternoon as planned, minus the sit that went nowhere.
